#### Branch description
<!-- Provide a concise overview of the issue or rationale behind the proposed changes. Minimum five words. -->
Added --video and --tracing options support to playwright test runner. Both options accept off (the default), on, and retain-on-failure values. retain-on-failure keep recording only when the test is failed, including failed subtest.

A trace is one zip per test. open a trace with `python -m playwright show-trace traces/chromium/<trace>.zip`. A video is one `.webm` per page.  Extra pages, including popups, are saved as `<test id>-2.webm`, `<test id>-3.webm`, and so on.
